Aisha: Quick decision needed on BYOK evidence SLA + retention default. Sales promised 48h exports to a prospect. Do we commit for MVP?
Priya: My recommendation: default retention = 90d, contract overrides allowed to 180d+. Legal-hold API required in MVP.
Marco: Tech proposal for MVP: deliver signed evidence bundle (manifest.json + gzipped audit slice) via pre-signed S3 URL within 72h. 48h is a paid SLA. For tenants >500GB we provide direct bucket transfer.
Sam: Ops needs: CLI to trigger exports, an ops runbook for failed exports/handshakes, and CI scenarios that simulate rotate->export flows.
Eve: From compliance: bundle must include signed handshake, signed rotation events (no key material), and a chain-of-custody manifest. Customers expect machine-parseable manifest (JSONL) and clear sampling metadata if partial export.
Aisha: Sounds reasonable. So MVP commit = 72h standard export, 48h paid SLA, S3 transfer for large volumes, legal-hold API, retention default 90d.
Priya: I'll draft the legal copy for the export SLA and escrow wording by Friday and loop Legal.
Marco: I'll stub the API endpoints and a simple manifest schema this week.
Sam: I'll PR the ops checklist and CI scenarios by Tue.
Eve: I'll validate package format with compliance and send feedback next week.
deploy-bot: RFC created: /rfc/byok-evidence-sla-and-retention (draft) — please review.
Aisha: Thanks all, reconvene after RFC comments. :thumbsup:
